(`following`) or from its next occurrence that hasn't begun (`all`).
The body carries the full new rule. Past, begun, completed and cancelled
occurrences are never rewritten. When the series has occurrences before
that date it is split: it ends the day before, and a new series (with

place. Future occurrences on a date the new rule keeps are moved (same
id; edited ones lose their exception), the others are cancelled
(`series_changed`), and new dates are created; a cancelled occurrence on
a kept date moves to the new series as it is. Every changed or new
occurrence is checked; any conflict refuses the whole change, unless an
`override` lists every soft conflict as a pair with the occurrence's
new instant (stored per occurrence and audited). `warnings` is always
empty for now.

room's windows (``[]`` clears them).

CloseoutApprovalRevision.description: One immutable approval revision (#78 E1): what payroll reads.

CloseoutCorrection.description:

members given change (`actual_minutes` 0-720; a `summary` member set to

don't see the lesson content; `fields` is empty for an attendance

CloseoutOnBehalf.description:

(#301 E3, E5). The closeout stays the tutor's (`submitted_by`).
`reason` is `null` for staff who don't see the lesson content.

marked absent; `homework` is optional. Each field is trimmed, at most
2000 characters.

version.title: Version
version.description: The closeout's version, as last read.

CloseoutTakeOver.description:

reviewer resubmits a closeout sent back to its tutor (the full
replacement of the minutes and the summary), with a reason.

CohortCreate.description:
A cohort of a course template (``POST /api/v1/cohorts``, #65 D1).

The template is frozen as its current version's snapshot; the session
length is the snapshot's (no ``duration_minutes``); the number of
sessions is the snapshot's, with ``COUNT`` derived around the known
closures (no ``until`` / ``count``); no ``rrule`` text and no students
(enrollment is #66). ``override`` (the #236 pairs) needs
``schedule.override``.

CohortDetail.title: CohortDetail
CohortDetail.description:
One cohort (``GET /api/v1/cohorts/{id}``, #65 F1, #66 F1, G3). The
syllabus comes from the snapshot, never from the live template.

``enrolled_count`` and ``roster`` are for ``course.view`` holders only:
for an enrolled student or a linked guardian they are absent, the
``series`` has no ``assignment`` (and its tutor only once they
accepted, by name only), its participants are only the caller's own
students, and ``next_occurrences`` are only the family-visible ones
they take part in. For the cohort's tutor (#246 A4) ``tutor_roster`` is
set, the ``series`` has no ``assignment``, and ``next_occurrences`` are
the tutor-visible ones they currently teach.

CohortRecurrence.description:
The cohort's weekly rule (#65 D1, E3): the weekdays and the interval
only. There is no ``until`` or ``count``: the server derives ``COUNT``
so that the template's sessions fall outside the closures known now.

CohortSessionItem.description:
One session of a cohort (#65 F4; #66 G4; #246 A5). Staff see every
state; a student or a guardian the family-visible sessions a visible
student takes part in, with ``students`` and the tutor's name only; the
cohort's tutor the tutor-visible sessions they currently teach, with
``participants``.

A cohort's syllabus, read from its template snapshot (never from the
live template): the modules and assessments in position order and the
completion criteria.

CohortTemplate.title: CohortTemplate

The template a cohort was created from, as its snapshot froze it: the
template's id, and its name and version at snapshot time.

CohortUpdate.description:

/api/v1/cohorts/{cohort_id}``, #65 E1). At least one of ``name`` and

reason.title: Reason

CohortWithdrawal.description:

the enrollment's ``version`` and an optional reason (trimmed, 1-1000:

can_record.title: Can Record
can_record.description: The scopes the viewer may record now (by role and age).

ConsentRecordItem.description: One consent record as the viewer sees it.

``amount``. ``status`` is against the center's local today:

``sort_order`` the level goes last (the current maximum + 10, at most
9999). It starts active.

One education level. ``active_subject_count`` counts only its active
subjects.

name and whether it is still active (an inactive level stays assigned and
is shown as such).

EducationLevelUpdate.description:

with the ``version`` the caller loaded. Fields not sent stay unchanged.

it). A field left out keeps its value.

`null` clears it.

edits never change existing evaluations.

name.title: Name

what you may do now.

version.title: Version
version.description: The evaluation's version, as last read.

FamilyScheduleClassroom.description: Where the session is: the classroom's name only.

Enroll a student in a group (``POST /api/v1/groups/{id}/enrollments``,

group-level conflicts (``group_capacity_exceeded`` of the initial

roster). For a student or a guardian the tutor is the name only, once
they accepted.

a student or a guardian the family-visible sessions a visible student

PriceCatalogReference.description:
A level, cohort or group an item points at: its id and current
name.

PriceCatalogSubject.title: PriceCatalogSubject
PriceCatalogSubject.description: The item's subject, with its own level's name.

PriceVersionCreate.title: PriceVersionCreate
PriceVersionCreate.description:
``POST /api/v1/billing/service-prices/{id}/versions`` (#89 B5).
``amount`` is required; an explicit ``null`` means "not offered from
this date".

PriceVersionItem.title: PriceVersionItem
PriceVersionItem.description:
One version (#89 B1). ``status`` is against the center's local
today: ``current`` is the version in effect, ``past`` an older one,
``upcoming`` one that starts later. ``amount: null`` means "not
offered".

version.title: Version
version.description: The version shown to the user; it must be the current one.

PrivacyNoticeAcceptanceRequest.title: PrivacyNoticeAcceptanceRequest
PrivacyNoticeAcceptanceRequest.description:
The version the user read and accepts
(``POST /api/v1/privacy-notice/acceptance``).

PrivacyNoticeAccepted.title: PrivacyNoticeAccepted
PrivacyNoticeAccepted.description: An acceptance of the current version (the first one, when repeated).

version.title: Version
version.description: The current version number.

body_es.title: Body Es
body_es.description: The Spanish text: plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines.

body_en.title: Body En
body_en.description: The English text: plain text, paragraphs separated by blank lines.

accepted_at.title: Accepted At
accepted_at.description: When the caller accepted this version, or null.

ProblemDetails.description: The body of every error response (RFC 9457 Problem Details).
ProblemDetails.title: ProblemDetails

attendance_percent.description: (present + late) / (present + late + absent) × 100, two places; null with no marked session.

evaluation_count.title: Evaluation Count
evaluation_count.description: Final, non-voided evaluations with evaluated_on in the range.

assignment_count.title: Assignment Count
assignment_count.description: Scored homework grades with graded_on in the range.

by_subject.title: By Subject
by_subject.description: Subjects with a value, by name (casefold), then id.

by_month.title: By Month
by_month.description: (month, subject) pairs with a value, by month, then subject name.

completion_percent.description: (submitted + graded) / (submitted + graded + missing) × 100 over the homework due in the range; null when none counts.

progress_percent.description: Done milestones / milestones × 100, a whole number (#81).

milestones_overdue.title: Milestones Overdue
milestones_overdue.description: Milestones not done whose due date is before the center's today; always 0 for a completed plan.

milestones_overdue.title: Milestones Overdue
milestones_overdue.description: The overdue milestones of the listed plans; completed plans count 0, so this is the active plans' sum.

items.title: Items
items.description: At most 20: active plans first by target date (none last), then completed plans, the latest completed first.

kind.description: weekly (a Monday to Sunday week), monthly (a calendar month) or on_demand (any period of at most 366 days).

period_start.title: Period Start
period_start.description: weekly: a Monday; monthly: the 1st; not after the center's today (period_invalid / period_in_future).

period_end.title: Period End
period_end.description: Required for on_demand; weekly and monthly derive it (a different value is period_invalid).

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: Optional: an active subject you currently teach the student (subject_unknown / report_subject_not_assigned). It never changes.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Up to 4000 characters; required to submit.

ProgressReportCreate.title: ProgressReportCreate
ProgressReportCreate.description:
`POST /api/v1/progress-reports` (#83 C1): a draft report about one of
your current students. Nobody sees it until you submit it, and families
only once a reviewer approves it.

ProgressReportFacts.title: ProgressReportFacts
ProgressReportFacts.description:
The facts the server compiled for the report's student, period and
subject (#83 B2, schema version 1): aggregates of records the family can
already see. Frozen at each submit; families see them exactly as
approved.

can_create.title: Can Create
can_create.description: Whether you may write a report about this student (a tutor who currently teaches them).

creatable_subjects.title: Creatable Subjects
creatable_subjects.description: The active subjects you currently teach the student, by name; empty without can_create (a report without a subject needs none).

ProgressReportFamilyPage.title: ProgressReportFamilyPage
ProgressReportFamilyPage.description:
A student's approved reports (#83 F3), with the caller's create hints
(AM2: not affected by the filters or the cursor).

ProgressReportFamilyView.title: ProgressReportFamilyView
ProgressReportFamilyView.description:
An approved progress report (#83 F2): the same closed shape for every
audience.

ProgressReportListItem.title: ProgressReportListItem
ProgressReportListItem.description: A report in the working list (#83 E2): no text.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: 1-1000 characters after trimming (reason_required / too_long). The author reads it; families never do.

author_user_id.title: Author User Id
author_user_id.description: An active tutor who currently teaches the student (schedule_author_invalid otherwise).

cadence.description: weekly (Monday to Sunday) or monthly (a calendar month), in the center's local dates.

subject_id.title: Subject Id
subject_id.description: Optional: an active subject the tutor currently teaches the student (subject_unknown / schedule_subject_not_assigned). Without it the reports cover all subjects.

starts_on.title: Starts On
starts_on.description: The first period that gets a draft: a Monday (weekly) or the 1st (monthly), from the current period on and at most 366 days ahead (schedule_starts_on_invalid). Default: the current period.

ProgressReportScheduleList.title: ProgressReportScheduleList
ProgressReportScheduleList.description:
`GET /api/v1/students/{id}/progress-report-schedules` (#316 C1):
active schedules first, then the newest, at most 100.

ProgressReportScheduleUpdate.title: ProgressReportScheduleUpdate
ProgressReportScheduleUpdate.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/progress-report-schedules/{id}` (#316 C3): deactivate
or reactivate. To change the tutor, cadence or subject, deactivate it
and add another.

subject.description: null: the reports cover all subjects.

ineligible_reason.description: Why no draft would be created now (the first failing rule), or null.

latest_period.description: null for an inactive schedule or before its first period has ended.

ProgressReportUpdate.title: ProgressReportUpdate
ProgressReportUpdate.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/progress-reports/{id}` (#83 C3): the narrative of a
draft or a report sent back for changes. Keys left out don't change;
`null` or blank text clears a field. The student, kind, period and
subject never change.

ProgressReportVersion.title: ProgressReportVersion
ProgressReportVersion.description: `POST …/submit` and `…/approve` (#83 D2, D3): the version you read.

facts.description: Frozen at the last submit; null for a draft never submitted.

facts_preview.description: A live compile, for the author while the report is a draft or sent back; null otherwise.

changes_requested.description: The last request for changes (kept until approval).

ProgressReportView.title: ProgressReportView
ProgressReportView.description:
One progress report (#83 E1): the author and
`progress_report.review` holders only.

QualificationCreate.title: QualificationCreate
QualificationCreate.description: A tutor's request to teach one subject (the level follows from it).

rejection_reason.title: Rejection Reason

revoked_at.title: Revoked At

revocation_reason.title: Revocation Reason
revocation_reason.description: The reviewer's revocation reason; set only for revoked.

QualificationItem.title: QualificationItem
QualificationItem.description: One qualification of a tutor, with its subject and level names.

reason.title: Reason

QualificationRevoke.title: QualificationRevoke
QualificationRevoke.description: A reviewer withdraws an approved qualification (#198 B1).

ReauthenticateRequest.title: ReauthenticateRequest
ReauthenticateRequest.description: The current user's password (#26). The same bounds as login.

reauthenticated_until.title: Reauthenticated Until
reauthenticated_until.description: When the 5-minute reauthentication window of this session ends (ISO 8601, UTC). Activity does not extend it.

ReauthenticateResponse.title: ReauthenticateResponse
ReauthenticateResponse.description:
The end of the session's reauthentication window (#26).

Holds no token, hash or session id.

username.title: Username
username.description: Normalized like a login username: 3 to 64 characters from a-z, 0-9, '.', '_' and '-' (letters are not case-sensitive).

RegistrationSubmitted.title: RegistrationSubmitted
RegistrationSubmitted.description: The answer to a registration request (``202``). Holds no id.

version.title: Version
version.description: The submission's version (send it back).

RosterEntry.title: RosterEntry
RosterEntry.description: One recipient's row in the working view.

RosterStudent.title: RosterStudent
RosterStudent.description:
A student of a tutor's group or cohort (#246 E2: the `limited`
level).

status.description: not_created; draft (the tutor's, no link); deleted (the tutor deleted the placeholder: it is never created again); submitted, changes_requested, approved_for_family or retracted (with report_id).

report_id.title: Report Id
report_id.description: Only for submitted, changes_requested, approved_for_family and retracted reports.

ScheduleLatestPeriod.title: ScheduleLatestPeriod
ScheduleLatestPeriod.description:
The latest ended period of an active schedule and what exists for it
(computed when read; nothing is stored).

``hard`` (never allowed) or ``soft`` (allowed with an override), and
code-specific details.

booking_notice_hours.title: Booking Notice Hours
booking_notice_hours.description: Hours of notice a booking needs (0 = none).

change_notice_hours.title: Change Notice Hours
change_notice_hours.description: A family's cancellation or reschedule later than this many hours before the start is late (0 = never late before the start).

response_hours.title: Response Hours
response_hours.description: Hours a tutor has to answer an offer (ADR-0005 D3).

makeup_after_on_time.title: Makeup After On Time
makeup_after_on_time.description: A makeup is allowed after an on-time cancellation.

makeup_after_late.title: Makeup After Late
makeup_after_late.description: A makeup is allowed after a late cancellation.

makeup_after_no_show.title: Makeup After No Show
makeup_after_no_show.description: A makeup is allowed after a no-show.

effective_from.title: Effective From
effective_from.description: When it takes effect: now when omitted; otherwise not in the past and later than every existing version (422 invalid_effective_from).

SchedulingPolicyCreate.title: SchedulingPolicyCreate
SchedulingPolicyCreate.description:
A new version: every rule, the latest version it replaces and when it
takes effect.

booking_notice_hours.title: Booking Notice Hours

change_notice_hours.description: A family's cancellation or reschedule later than this many hours before the start is late (0 = never late before the start).

response_hours.title: Response Hours
response_hours.description: Hours a tutor has to answer an offer (ADR-0005 D3).

makeup_after_on_time.title: Makeup After On Time
makeup_after_on_time.description: A makeup is allowed after an on-time cancellation.

makeup_after_late.title: Makeup After Late

makeup_window_days.title: Makeup Window Days
makeup_window_days.description: Days after the missed class within which a makeup happens.

SchedulingPolicyItem.title: SchedulingPolicyItem
SchedulingPolicyItem.description:
One policy version, in force from ``effective_from`` until the next
version's ``effective_from``.

upcoming.title: Upcoming
upcoming.description: Versions that take effect later, oldest first.

history.title: History
history.description: Versions no longer in force, newest first (at most 50).

SchedulingPolicyOverview.title: SchedulingPolicyOverview
SchedulingPolicyOverview.description: The version in force now, the upcoming ones and the past ones.

SchedulingWarning.title: SchedulingWarning
SchedulingWarning.description:
A rule that never blocks (ADR-0005 warnings; #50 A): the tutor's
teaching limits and required break (:mod:`~app.modules.scheduling.workload`).

``details``: ``daily_limit_exceeded`` ``{date, limit_minutes,
scheduled_minutes}``; ``weekly_limit_exceeded`` ``{week_start,
limit_minutes, scheduled_minutes}`` (``week_start`` is the Monday of the
ISO week); ``break_too_short`` ``{class_session_id, gap_minutes,
required_break_minutes}``.

from_date.title: From Date
from_date.description: The local date it covers from.

offer_id.title: Offer Id
offer_id.description: The series offer; null for a series assigned before offers.

SeriesAssignment.title: SeriesAssignment
SeriesAssignment.description:
The series' tutor assignment (#233 F2): ``pending`` while its series
offer waits for an answer (``respond_by`` set), ``accepted`` after.

skipped_closure_kept.title: Skipped Closure Kept
skipped_closure_kept.description: Rows skipped for a closure, left as they are.

SeriesCancelSummary.title: SeriesCancelSummary
SeriesCancelSummary.description: What a cancellation did to the occurrence rows.

moved.title: Moved
moved.description: Rows kept (same id) with the new rule.

created.title: Created
created.description: Rows created for dates the old rule lacked.

cancelled.title: Cancelled
cancelled.description: Rows cancelled (`series_changed`): their date left the rule.

skipped_closure.title: Skipped Closure
skipped_closure.description: Moved or created rows that are on a closure date.

exceptions_reset.title: Exceptions Reset
exceptions_reset.description: Edited occurrences that took the new rule's times.

SeriesEditSummary.title: SeriesEditSummary
SeriesEditSummary.description: What an edit did to the occurrence rows.

overridden.title: Overridden
overridden.description: Whether at least one override of its soft conflicts names it (#236).

conflict_codes.title: Conflict Codes
conflict_codes.description: The codes that put it in `conflict` (informational; kept after it leaves `conflict`; #236).

version.title: Version
version.description: The session's version (#236).

SeriesOccurrence.title: SeriesOccurrence
SeriesOccurrence.description: One occurrence row of a series.

pairs.title: Pairs
pairs.description: The (occurrence_start, code) pairs to override, 1-1400, no duplicates (instants compared in UTC).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the rules are overridden: 1-1000 characters, trimmed.

SeriesOverride.title: SeriesOverride
SeriesOverride.description:
The soft conflicts of a series write to override, occurrence by
occurrence, and why (#236 B1; ADR-0005 D4: "listed occurrence and code
pairs"). The server recomputes every occurrence's conflicts: a hard one
is never overridden, every soft one must be listed with its occurrence,
and listed pairs that don't occur are ignored. ``reason`` is the #49
reason (trimmed, 1-1000).

weekdays.title: Weekdays
weekdays.description: ISO weekdays (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday), at least one, no duplicates.

until.title: Until
until.description: The last local date (inclusive); not together with `count`.

count.title: Count
count.description: How many occurrences in all (1-200), the ones skipped for a closure included; not together with `until`.

SeriesRecurrence.title: SeriesRecurrence
SeriesRecurrence.description:
A weekly rule as structured fields (ADR-0005 D4): the API never takes
``RRULE`` text. The ranges are checked after the locks, as ``422`` on
``recurrence.<field>`` (``weekdays_empty``, ``weekday_out_of_range``,
``weekdays_duplicate``, ``interval_out_of_range``, ``until_and_count``,
``count_out_of_range``, ``until_before_start``; ``no_occurrences`` on
``recurrence``).

ServicePriceCreate.title: ServicePriceCreate
ServicePriceCreate.description:
``POST /api/v1/billing/service-prices``: the item's key and its first
version (#89 B3). Fields are in rule order (see the module docstring).

ServicePriceDetail.title: ServicePriceDetail
ServicePriceDetail.description: An item with all its versions, newest ``effective_from`` first.

ServicePriceItem.title: ServicePriceItem
ServicePriceItem.description:
One catalog item (#89 B1). ``education_level`` and
``duration_minutes`` ``null`` mean "any"; ``cohort``/``group`` scope it.
``current`` is the version in effect today (``amount: null`` = not
offered) and ``next`` the earliest upcoming one.

SessionAttendance.title: SessionAttendance
SessionAttendance.description:
A session's attendance (#76 B2): every participant, by display name,
marked or not. `can_mark`: you are the current tutor and the tutor may
mark now; `can_correct`: you hold attendance.correct and a correction is
possible now; `block`: why attendance can't be written now for you
(`attendance_not_recordable`, `attendance_not_started`,
`attendance_locked`), or `null`. Any change bumps the session's
`version`.

SessionCancellation.title: SessionCancellation
SessionCancellation.description: When and why a session was cancelled (#55 E3).

SessionClassroom.title: SessionClassroom
SessionClassroom.description: The session's classroom (an inactive room stays shown as such).

version.title: Version
version.description: The closeout's version: send it to approve, request changes, correct or resubmit.

actual_minutes.title: Actual Minutes
actual_minutes.description: The actual teaching minutes (stored on the session).

approval_request_id.title: Approval Request Id
approval_request_id.description: The item in the approval inbox.

approval.description: The current approval revision (in force for payroll), if any.

attendance_changed_since_approval.title: Attendance Changed Since Approval
attendance_changed_since_approval.description: The attendance differs from the current approval's snapshot.

on_behalf.description: Set when a reviewer made the latest submission on the tutor's behalf (#301); cleared when the tutor resubmits.

SessionCloseoutRecord.title: SessionCloseoutRecord
SessionCloseoutRecord.description:
A submitted closeout. Submitted hours are not approved until a
reviewer approves them (`approval`); a correction never changes an
approved revision, it adds one (`revisions`, newest first). `summary`
is `null` with `summary_hidden: true` for staff who may see the minutes
but not the lesson content.

version.title: Version
version.description: The session's version, as last read.

SessionCloseoutSubmit.title: SessionCloseoutSubmit
SessionCloseoutSubmit.description:
`POST /api/v1/class-sessions/{id}/closeout` (#77 D1): the session's
version, the actual teaching minutes (0-720) and the structured
summary. Every participant's attendance must be marked first.

version.title: Version
version.description: The session's version (send it back).

can_review.title: Can Review
can_review.description: You may approve or request changes now (a submitted closeout that isn't your own).

can_correct.title: Can Correct
can_correct.description: You may correct the minutes or the summary now.

can_resubmit.title: Can Resubmit
can_resubmit.description: You submitted it and changes were requested.

can_request_correction.title: Can Request Correction
can_request_correction.description: You submitted it and it is approved.

can_request_changes.title: Can Request Changes
can_request_changes.description: You may send it back to the tutor now: `can_review`, and it wasn't submitted on the tutor's behalf (#301).

can_submit_on_behalf.title: Can Submit On Behalf
can_submit_on_behalf.description: You hold teaching_hours.approve, the class has ended without a closeout and you don't tutor it (#301).

can_take_over.title: Can Take Over
can_take_over.description: You hold teaching_hours.approve, changes were requested and you aren't its tutor: resubmit it on the tutor's behalf (#301).

SessionCloseoutView.title: SessionCloseoutView
SessionCloseoutView.description:
A session's closeout (#77 C2). `can_submit`: you are the current
tutor and the session can be closed out now (even with attendance
missing: `attendance` lists who). `block`: why it can't
(`session_not_started`, `session_not_closable`,
`closeout_already_submitted`, or `closeout_tutor_only` for staff), or
`null`. `closeout` is `null` until one is submitted, also for a
completed session without one.

attendance.description: This student's own mark (null: not recorded).

summary.description: Only while the session's closeout is approved (null when none, under review, sent back or empty).

published_note_count.title: Published Note Count
published_note_count.description: The tutor's notes about this student in this session that are shared with the family.

SessionLogSummary.title: SessionLogSummary
SessionLogSummary.description: The approved closeout summary (`null` members: left empty).

body.description: The note: plain text, trimmed, 1-4000 characters (body_required / too_long).

SessionNoteCreate.title: SessionNoteCreate
SessionNoteCreate.description:
`POST /api/v1/class-sessions/{id}/notes` (#79 C1): a note about one
participant of the session. It is always created internal: families
never see it until you share it.

version.title: Version
version.description: The note's version, as last read.

body.description: The note: plain text, trimmed, 1-4000 characters.

SessionNoteEdit.title: SessionNoteEdit
SessionNoteEdit.description:
`PATCH /api/v1/notes/{id}` (#79 D2): the new text of an internal
note.

version.title: Version
version.description: The note's version, as last read.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it stops being shared: 1-500 characters, trimmed; required unless you wrote the note (reason_required / reason_too_long).

SessionNoteUnpublish.title: SessionNoteUnpublish
SessionNoteUnpublish.description:

most 500 characters) is required from anyone but the author.

version.title: Version
version.description: The note's version, as last read.

version.title: Version
version.description: The note's version (send it back).

unpublished_at.title: Unpublished At
unpublished_at.description: When it last stopped being shared (cleared when shared again).

edited.title: Edited
edited.description: The text changed after it was written.

SessionNoteView.title: SessionNoteView
SessionNoteView.description:
A tutor's note about one student in one session (#79 C3), for staff
with academic_note.review and tutors. `visibility`: `internal` notes are
never shown to families; `family` notes are shared with the student and
their guardians with academic access. The `can_*` flags say what you may
do now.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: The soft conflict codes to override, 1-7, no duplicates; never a hard code.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the rules are overridden: 1-1000 characters, trimmed.

SessionOverride.title: SessionOverride
SessionOverride.description:
The soft conflicts to override and why (#49 B1; ADR-0005). The server
recomputes every conflict: a hard one is never overridden, and every soft
one must be listed; listed codes that don't occur are ignored.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: The overridden soft codes, in rule order.

SessionOverrideItem.title: SessionOverrideItem
SessionOverrideItem.description: One override of a session's soft conflicts (#49 E1).

SessionParticipantName.title: SessionParticipantName
SessionParticipantName.description: A student of a session the caller teaches (#246 A5; #67 B4).

SessionReassignment.title: SessionReassignment
SessionReassignment.description:
An open reassignment flag (M4-18 #63 E2): the tutor's availability
changed and the session needs another tutor. Staff-only.

tutor_user_id.title: Tutor User Id
tutor_user_id.description: The qualified tutor the session is offered to (required).

classroom_id.title: Classroom Id
classroom_id.description: The classroom; null is no room.

respond_by.title: Respond By
respond_by.description: An earlier deadline for the tutor's answer, after now and no later than the default (#52). Null or absent: the default.

override.description: Override the listed soft conflicts with a reason (needs schedule.override).

SessionRequestConfirmed.title: SessionRequestConfirmed
SessionRequestConfirmed.description:

session it created (``offered`` to the tutor, with #50's warnings).

starts_at.description: An instant with an offset (RFC 3339), on the 30-minute local grid (:00 or :30 in the center zone).

note.title: Note
note.description: An optional note for the center (trimmed, at most 500).

SessionRequestCreate.title: SessionRequestCreate
SessionRequestCreate.description:

(``422`` through ``extra="forbid"``): the center chooses the tutor.

can_withdraw.description: You made it and it is still pending.

rejection_reason.title: Rejection Reason
rejection_reason.description: Why the center rejected it (only when `rejected`; #60 E5).

SessionRequestDetail.title: SessionRequestDetail
SessionRequestDetail.description: A request as a family sees it (#59 D2; S3 allow-list).

can_withdraw.title: Can Withdraw
can_withdraw.description: You made it and it is still pending.

rejection_reason.title: Rejection Reason
rejection_reason.description: Why the center rejected it (only when `rejected`; #60 E5).

SessionRequestItem.description: A list item: the same members as the detail.

can_decide.description: Pending and not yet started: it can be confirmed (a started one can still be rejected).

SessionRequestReview.title: SessionRequestReview
SessionRequestReview.description: A session request as staff review it (#60 B2; ``schedule.manage``).

is_active.description: False when the subject or its level is.

SessionSubject.description:
The session's subject with its level's name. ``is_active`` is false
when the subject or its level is inactive.

SessionTutor.title: SessionTutor
SessionTutor.description: The tutor the session is offered to, or who teaches it.

csrf_token.description: The session's CSRF token: send it as X-CSRF-Token on POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE. Keep it in memory only.

privacy_notice_required.description: True until the user accepts the current privacy-notice version (#174). Meanwhile every route except /auth/me, /auth/logout, /auth/me/preferences and the privacy-notice routes answers 403 privacy_notice_required.

center_time_zone.title: Center Time Zone
center_time_zone.description: The center's IANA time zone (business settings, #37). The web app shows instants and computes today's date in it.

The signed-in user (``POST /auth/login``, ``GET /auth/me`` and
``POST /auth/password``).

Holds no password hash, session token or session id. ``csrf_token`` is
the session's CSRF token: the SPA keeps it in memory and sends it as
``X-CSRF-Token`` on ``POST``, ``PUT``, ``PATCH`` and ``DELETE``.

tutor_user_id.title: Tutor User Id
tutor_user_id.description: The tutor to offer the session to; null creates it unassigned.

classroom_id.title: Classroom Id
classroom_id.description: The classroom; null is no room.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: How many slots to return at most: 1-10, default 5.

search_from.title: Search From
search_from.description: The first local date (center zone) to search; default the local date of starts_at.

search_to.title: Search To
search_to.description: The last local date to search, at most 14 dates in all; default search_from + 6 days.

SlotSuggestionRequest.title: SlotSuggestionRequest
SlotSuggestionRequest.description:
``POST /api/v1/class-sessions/suggestions`` (#50 B1): the session's
members (the requested start and end give only the duration and the
ranking anchor) plus the search. No ``override``: only slots that need
none are returned.

slots.title: Slots
slots.description: 0 to limit slots, nearest the requested start first (a tie goes to the earlier start).

SlotSuggestions.title: SlotSuggestions
SlotSuggestions.description: The free times nearest the requested start (#50 B5, B7).

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: An account that isn't archived and isn't linked to another student, or null to unlink.

StudentAccountUpdate.title: StudentAccountUpdate
StudentAccountUpdate.description:
Link a login account to the profile, or ``null`` to unlink it (``PUT
/api/v1/students/{student_id}/account``), with the ``version`` the caller
loaded.

can_submit.title: Can Submit
can_submit.description: You are the student and may submit now.

can_grade.title: Can Grade
can_grade.description: You set it and may grade it now.

StudentAssignment.title: StudentAssignment
StudentAssignment.description:
A homework assignment with one student's submission (#82 E2): the same
closed shape for staff, tutors, the student and guardians.

StudentAssignmentList.title: StudentAssignmentList
StudentAssignmentList.description:
`GET /api/v1/students/{id}/assignments` (#82 E3): the summary counts
the whole filtered set (ignoring `state` and the cursor).

StudentBalanceItem.title: StudentBalanceItem
StudentBalanceItem.description:
One student's open amounts on the account. Account credit is
account-level only.

StudentCompletion.title: StudentCompletion
StudentCompletion.description:
One actively enrolled student's completion (E5: ``in_progress`` until
the course is final for them).

birthdate.title: Birthdate
birthdate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 up to today in the center's time zone.

school_grade.title: School Grade
school_grade.description: Free text, for example 2.º de secundaria.

education_level_id.title: Education Level Id
education_level_id.description: An active level of the catalog.

StudentCreate.title: StudentCreate
StudentCreate.description:
A new student profile (``POST /api/v1/students``). It starts active.
The list order of ``emergency_contacts`` (1 to 5) is their order.

education_level.description: Shown even when the level is inactive.

guardians.title: Guardians
guardians.description: The linked guardians, by family names then given names; null unless the viewer holds a staff role and guardian.view.

family.description: The family this profile belongs to (#172); null when it belongs to none or the viewer may not see it. Shown only to viewers with a staff role and guardian.view.

login.description: The linked login account (#35); null when none is linked or the viewer doesn't hold family.manage.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

StudentDetail.title: StudentDetail
StudentDetail.description:
One student profile. ``personal`` is ``null`` for a viewer with
limited access (Finance Staff, assigned tutors, a linked guardian of an
adult student). ``guardians`` is ``null`` for viewers without a staff
role and ``guardian.view``.

has_account.title: Has Account
has_account.description: The profile is linked to a login.

StudentGuardianItem.title: StudentGuardianItem
StudentGuardianItem.description: A guardian linked to a student, as staff see it on the student.

is_minor.title: Is Minor
is_minor.description: Under 18 today in the center's time zone (ADR-0007 D17).

StudentListItem.title: StudentListItem
StudentListItem.description: One student in the list. No birthdate or contact data (spec §16).

StudentLogin.title: StudentLogin
StudentLogin.description:
The student's login account, shown only to ``family.manage`` holders
(#35 C3).

StudentPersonal.title: StudentPersonal
StudentPersonal.description: The personal part of a profile, only for full-access viewers.

subjects.title: Subjects
subjects.description: Every subject of the range whatever the subject filter (sessions, counted grades, homework, listed plans), by name (casefold), then id: the options of a subject filter.

attendance_by_month.title: Attendance By Month
attendance_by_month.description: Every month of the range, oldest first, zeros included.

updated.title: Updated
updated.description: The grade was changed after it was given.

version.title: Version
version.description: The submission's version (send it back).

StudentSubmission.title: StudentSubmission
StudentSubmission.description: One student's submission and grade (#82 E2).

anyOf.description: YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 up to today in the center's time zone.

StudentUpdate.title: StudentUpdate
StudentUpdate.description:
A change to a profile (``PATCH /api/v1/students/{student_id}``) with
the ``version`` the caller loaded. ``emergency_contacts``, when sent, is
the complete new list (contacts left out are removed).

SubjectCreate.title: SubjectCreate
SubjectCreate.description: A new subject of the level in the path. It starts active.

SubjectDetail.title: SubjectDetail
SubjectDetail.description: One subject with its level's id and current name.

SubjectUpdate.title: SubjectUpdate
SubjectUpdate.description:
A change to a subject (``PATCH /api/v1/subjects/{subject_id}``) with
the ``version`` the caller loaded. The level can't be changed.

version.title: Version
version.description: The submission's version, as last read: required when something was already submitted (version_required).

url.title: Url
url.description: An absolute http or https link with a host, no user name or password, at most 2000 characters (url_invalid). Never opened by the server.

SubmissionPut.title: SubmissionPut
SubmissionPut.description:
`PUT /api/v1/assignments/{id}/students/{student_id}/submission` (#82
D1): the student submits text and/or a link (at least one), or the tutor
who set the homework records work handed in on paper (both may be
empty). Replacing an existing submission needs its version.

version.title: Version
version.description: The session's version, as last read.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the tutor is replaced, for the staff (never shown to the substitute): 1-1000 characters, trimmed.

respond_by.title: Respond By
respond_by.description: An earlier deadline for the substitute's answer, after now and no later than the default; truncated to whole minutes.

override.description: Override the listed soft conflicts with a reason (needs schedule.override).

SubstitutionCreate.title: SubstitutionCreate
SubstitutionCreate.description:
Offer one ``confirmed`` session to a substitute tutor (``POST
/api/v1/class-sessions/{id}/substitutions``, #55 B2). ``reason`` is
trimmed, 1-1000 characters (``reason_required`` /
``reason_too_long``).

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: The substitute's workload warnings for the session. They never block.

SubstitutionCreated.title: SubstitutionCreated
SubstitutionCreated.description: The new substitution and the substitute's workload warnings.

SubstitutionItem.title: SubstitutionItem
SubstitutionItem.description:
One substitution of a session's tutor (#55 E1); ``status`` is its
offer's.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: The workload warnings a create at this time would get.

SuggestedSlot.title: SuggestedSlot
SuggestedSlot.description: One free time: every hard and soft rule passes (#50 B4).

TeachingLimitsDetail.title: TeachingLimitsDetail
TeachingLimitsDetail.description:
A tutor's teaching limits (#197), in minutes; null is no limit (no
break). Exceeding them is a warning when scheduling (M4-05), never a
block.

TeachingSubject.title: TeachingSubject
TeachingSubject.description:
A subject the tutor holds an **approved** qualification for (#44 D1).
A subject deactivated later stays, with ``subject_is_active`` false.

weekly.title: Weekly
weekly.description: The weekly windows by weekday, then start.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.description: By starts_on, then starts_at (whole days first).

preferred_classrooms.title: Preferred Classrooms
preferred_classrooms.description: By name. A room deactivated after it was chosen stays, with is_active false.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version of the weekly windows, limits and preferred classrooms together; 0 while they were never changed.

pending_changes.title: Pending Changes
pending_changes.description: Changes waiting for approval because they affect scheduled classes, oldest first (M4-18).

recent_changes.title: Recent Changes
recent_changes.description: The last 5 decided or withdrawn change requests, newest first.

TutorAvailabilityDetail.title: TutorAvailabilityDetail
TutorAvailabilityDetail.description:
A tutor's availability in the center's local wall-clock time, with
the teaching limits and preferred classrooms (#197).

version.title: Version
version.description: The profile's version; 0 while the tutor has no stored profile (the first edit creates it, at version 1).

editable_fields.title: Editable Fields
editable_fields.description: The fields the caller may change, sorted; empty: read only. Sending another field is 403 permission_denied.

teaching_subjects.title: Teaching Subjects
teaching_subjects.description: The subjects of the tutor's approved qualifications, by the level's order, then the subject name.

TutorDetail.title: TutorDetail
TutorDetail.description: One tutor profile, with what the caller may edit.

TutorListItem.title: TutorListItem
TutorListItem.description:
One tutor: a user holding the ``tutor`` role, with the account's
contact fields.

TutorName.title: TutorName
TutorName.description:
Who teaches, for a student or a guardian: the display name only
(#246 A5; #67 E4), and only once the tutor accepted.

TutorOption.title: TutorOption
TutorOption.description:
A user holding the tutor role, for the calendar's tutor filter. No
contact data.

TutorOptions.title: TutorOptions
TutorOptions.description: The matching tutors, in the user list order.

TutorRosterItem.title: TutorRosterItem
TutorRosterItem.description:
An active enrollment of a group or cohort the caller teaches (#246
E2): the student only, never who enrolled them or a withdrawal.

TutorSchedule.title: TutorSchedule
TutorSchedule.description:
The tutor's sessions overlapping the range, by ``starts_at`` then
``id``; at most 1000, with ``truncated`` true when more match.

TutorScheduleItem.title: TutorScheduleItem
TutorScheduleItem.description: One session on a tutor's schedule (#67 B4).

TutorScheduleParticipant.title: TutorScheduleParticipant
TutorScheduleParticipant.description: A student of the tutor's session.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: The position in the ranking, from 1.

weekly_minutes.title: Weekly Minutes
weekly_minutes.description: Scheduled minutes as tutor (offered, confirmed, completed) starting in the slot's local ISO week.

daily_minutes.title: Daily Minutes
daily_minutes.description: The same, starting on the slot's local date.

prefers_classroom.title: Prefers Classroom
prefers_classroom.description: The slot has a classroom and it is one of the tutor's preferred.

TutorSuggestion.title: TutorSuggestion
TutorSuggestion.description:
An eligible tutor and the values of the workload ranking rule.
The limits are shown only: they never drop or reorder a tutor.

TutorSuggestionList.title: TutorSuggestionList
TutorSuggestionList.description:
The first ``limit`` eligible tutors in ranking order, and how many
are eligible in all (advisory: creating or offering re-checks
everything).

version.title: Version
version.description: The version the caller loaded (0: no profile yet).

TutorUpdate.title: TutorUpdate
TutorUpdate.description:
A profile change (``PATCH /api/v1/tutors/{user_id}``). Fields not sent
stay unchanged; ``""`` or ``null`` clears ``email``, ``phone`` or
``professional_experience``.

UnbilledRecord.title: UnbilledRecord
UnbilledRecord.description: A referenced record: its id and current name.

service_date.title: Service Date
service_date.description: The session's local date in the center's time zone.

family.description: The student's family (null: none, reason no_billing_account).

UnbilledSessionItem.title: UnbilledSessionItem
UnbilledSessionItem.description:
One confirmed or completed individual session participant the
sweeper skips (``GET /api/v1/billing/unbilled-items``).

assignable_roles.title: Assignable Roles
assignable_roles.description: Roles the caller may add to and remove from this user, in the catalog order (empty: the roles are read-only).

manage_delegations.title: Manage Delegations
manage_delegations.description: The caller may grant and revoke this user's delegated permissions (an Owner, and the user holds administrator).

UserAllowedActions.title: UserAllowedActions
UserAllowedActions.description:
What the caller may do to this user, computed by the server with the
routes' rules (the routes stay the authority). The last-active-Owner guard
is not considered (the server answers ``409 last_active_owner``).

UserDelegationsUpdate.title: UserDelegationsUpdate
UserDelegationsUpdate.description:
The Administrator's complete set of delegated permissions (``PUT
/api/v1/users/{user_id}/delegations``) and the version the caller
loaded.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role codes, in the catalog order.

version.title: Version
version.description: Send it back with every change.

delegations.title: Delegations
delegations.description: Delegated permission codes, sorted (changed with PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/delegations).

password_set.title: Password Set
password_set.description: Whether the account has a password: a pending account without one is an open invitation, with one a registration request.

UserDetail.title: UserDetail
UserDetail.description: One user's account. Holds no password hash or token.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Role codes, in the catalog order.

UserListItem.title: UserListItem
UserListItem.description:
One user in the list. No contact fields, password data or delegations
(spec §16: minimal exposure).

language.description: The UI language, or null when never stored.

theme.description: The theme choice, or null when never stored.

UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description:
The signed-in user's stored preferences (``SessionUser.preferences``).

``null`` means the user has never stored the value.

UserPreferencesUpdate.title: UserPreferencesUpdate
UserPreferencesUpdate.description:
``PATCH /api/v1/auth/me/preferences``: one or both values.

A field that is not sent stays as it is. ``null`` is refused (a stored
value can't be cleared), so is an empty body and any other field.

UserRolesUpdate.title: UserRolesUpdate
UserRolesUpdate.description:
The user's complete set of roles (``PUT /api/v1/users/{user_id}/roles``)
and the version the caller loaded. At least one role: a roleless account
is only a registration request (#169).

UserStateChange.title: UserStateChange
UserStateChange.description: Suspend, archive or reactivate: the version the caller loaded.

UserUpdate.title: UserUpdate
UserUpdate.description:
A profile change (``PATCH /api/v1/users/{user_id}``). Fields that are not
sent stay unchanged; ``""`` or ``null`` clears ``email`` or ``phone``. The
username never changes (ADR-0007 D7).

version.title: Version
version.description: The availability version the caller loaded (0: never changed).

windows.title: Windows
windows.description: At most 42 windows; windows of one weekday may touch but not overlap. Local wall-clock times of the center.

WeeklyAvailabilityUpdate.title: WeeklyAvailabilityUpdate
WeeklyAvailabilityUpdate.description:
The tutor's full list of weekly windows
(``PUT /api/v1/tutors/{user_id}/availability/weekly``); ``[]`` clears
them.

app__modules__scheduling__schedule_schem.title: ScheduleSubject
app__modules__scheduling__schedule_schem.description: The session's subject with its level's name.
